name: qa-payment
description: Payment platform testing: Stripe test cards + webhooks, Stripe subscription-billing test clocks, the Adyen / PayPal / Braintree sandbox umbrella (payment-gateway-sandboxes), the payment lifecycle state-machine + 3DS flow reference, and the payment-flow-test-author workflow for refund / chargeback / webhook-replay suites. Distinct from qa-compliance/pci-dss-control-test-author (PCI DSS scope + control verification); this plugin is platform-specific sandbox testing + payment flow suites.
